item.title: In Hormuz deadlock, U.S. and Iran refuse to back down
item.description: The U.S. and Iran remain deadlocked in the Strait of Hormuz, with no clear way forward.

item.title: UAE denies Netanyahu secretly visited the country during the Iran war
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu quietly visited the United Arab Emirates during the Israeli-U.S. war with Iran, his office said Wednesday. The UAE later denied any secret visit had occurred.

item.title: Senate confirms Kevin Warsh as next chair of the Federal Reserve
item.description: Warsh has argued there's room for the central bank to lower interest rates, but that could be challenging at a time of rising inflation.
